title: Tomb-land Security - Level 6
description: Tomb-land Security - Level 6 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ticked Tomb Curator

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 20 Tomblifters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ticked Tomb Curator

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Enter the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag, slay 20 Tomblifters there, and return to the Ticked Tomb Curator in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Despite your heroic efforts the Tomblifters are growing in number and smugness. It is almost like they are openly rebelling against our authority! In you, it seems, they found an authority figure that they can all get behind and stab in the back. Here, I received this note from one of them and it says they challenge you to a fight after the tomb closes. While I won't let you answer their challenge, I do want you to get back into that tomb and hand out some old school DPS.

Surprise the Tomblifters in the Tomb of the AFK Bolshevist in Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Attack them without mercy and don't stop until 20 of them lay loot-less on the floor. Make the tomb they once dillydallied in be there final resting place, not just somewhere they can go to hang out and get free Air Conditioning! When you have taken care of things in the tomb return to me, the Ticked Tomb Curator, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Have they learned their lesson? No, well I should expect nothing less. Doesn't it make you angry how they defy your jurisdiction? Angry enough to try it again?

Objectives:

  • Slay Tomblifters

Level range: 92–100
